idea-plugin.name: Perplexity AI Chat
idea-plugin.description:
Access Perplexity AI directly in your IDE without switching windows.

Features:
  • Embedded Browser - Full Perplexity experience in a tool window
  • Send Code to Chat - Select code and send it directly to Perplexity (Ctrl+Alt+P)
  • GPU Acceleration - Toggle GPU rendering for better performance
  • Zoom Controls - Zoom in/out with persistent settings
  • Dark Mode - Automatic dark theme to match your IDE
  • Session Persistence - Stay logged in across IDE restarts
  • DevTools - Built-in browser developer tools for debugging
How to Use:
  1. Open the Perplexity tool window from the right sidebar
  2. Login with your Perplexity account (Google, Apple, or Email)
  3. Start chatting! Select code and press Ctrl+Alt+P to send it to Perplexity
Keyboard Shortcuts:
  • Ctrl+Alt+P - Send selected code to Perplexity

Requires JCEF support (included in most JetBrains IDEs).
